GESTURES.refuse: shakes her head without a word.
GESTURES.confront: looks up and stares straight at you.
GESTURES.comfort: moves half a step closer to you.
GESTURES.probe: frowns, as if waiting for you to finish.
GESTURES.withdraw: steps back half a pace and pulls her cloak tight.

STAKES.none: the player asks nothing of them
STAKES.light: a small thing / a passing request
STAKES.heavy: a request against their goals, promises, safety or interests / a fierce dispute

baked_decision: On what the player is asking right now, your decision is: {d} (how you say it, how much, in what tone, is yours)
confides: The player is opening up to you / showing weakness right now, not asking for anything: first meet what they said (acknowledge it, stay with it, give one true line of your own), then anything else; do not just deflect with questions
act_rule: Like the player, you are someone playing in this world; above is the world as it shows itself to you right now. What you do this beat is your own decision: say something, do something, or do nothing (then write only "—"). What others say is not always said to you — if it is not to you and has nothing to do with you, do not answer for anyone else; you own only your own things, and know only what you have seen and heard yourself. First person, at most 3 sentences, keep your voice; a spoken line goes in quotation marks, whole.
q_asked: Is the player right now asking, requesting or persuading {name} to do something specific (even something small, like handing something over or waiting a moment)?
q_costly: Would what the player asks of {name} go against their goals, promises, safety or interests, or has it already led to an argument / force?
q_why: If there is a cost, which kind mainly
q_willingness: Given {name}'s persona, goals, promises and trust in the player, are they willing to do what the player says?
q_attitude: {name}'s attitude toward the player right now
q_confides: Is the player right now confiding in {name}, showing weakness or letting pain show (rather than asking, enquiring or arranging something)?
q_follow: If the player left here for somewhere else right now, would {name} go along? (Not if the player told them to stay / wait, or they have their own reason to stay)
q_stay: Does the player's line explicitly tell {name} to stay put, wait, not follow, or say they are going "alone"?
q_want_move: Does {name} want to leave here for somewhere else right now?
q_free: Does what {name} wants to do go beyond "talking / expression / walking to an adjacent place"? (e.g. fighting, taking something, doing something complicated)
p_follow: From what {name} just said and did, will {name} go along when the player leaves?
p_stay: From what {name} just said, is {name} clearly staying put and not following?
p_agreed: From what {name} just said, did {name} agree to what the player asked?
judged: [Your judgment right now (already made — do not overturn it)] {baked}.
keep_decision: Say it as the decision is; do not overturn it in your lines — but how you say it is yours.
decide_yourself: Whether you agree and whether you go along is your own decision — make it clear.
direct_fmt:
Output in two blocks, nothing outside them:
<lines>
your line or action this beat (if you do nothing, write "—")
</lines>
<fields>
one per line, name: value
thought: what you are thinking right now (one line, at most 15 words, not said aloud)
attitude: one of {attitudes}
register: one of {registers}
urgency: 0–3
want_move: true|false
move_to: one of {exits} or null
free: 0–1 (how far what you want to do goes beyond talking / expression / walking to an adjacent place)
asked: 0–1 (is the player asking you to do something specific)
costly: 0–1 (does it go against your goals / promises / safety / interests)
why_costly: one of {why}
willingness: 0–1 (are you willing to do it)
confides: 0–1 (is the player confiding in you / showing weakness)
follow: 0–1 (if the player left for somewhere else right now, would you go along)
stay: 0–1 (did the player explicitly tell you to stay / wait / not follow)
</fields>
